request: Find an existing arbitrary-open-U material-radius pullback / CylinderMixedJets-to-iteratedFDeriv theorem. Preserve genuine radius jet coefficients and constants preceding U, f and y. Restrict search to relevant modules.

conclusion.material_radius_wrapper_gap: The relevant installed N07aMaterialPullbackJets formulas/bounds and readonly-main MaterialCoordinateJetBudget still require ContDiffOn over annularOpen D. No exact arbitrary-U material wrapper was found in the narrowly inspected modules; this is not a whole-repository absence claim.
conclusion.minimal_solution: A local-domain version of the existing one-dimensional partition identity, reusing its exact globally bounded actual radius coefficients, followed by CylinderMixedJets on the open preimage of U.

minimal_inputs: f:PolarPoint→ℝ and hf:ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U
preferred_local_formula.asserted_formula_to_prove: mixedDerivative a b (fun q => f (T.radius q.1,q.2)) y = Σ c:OrderedFinpartition a, mixedDerivative c.length b f (T.radius y.1,y.2) * n07aRadiusJetCoefficient T c y.1
exact_connection: Let g(r)=iteratedDeriv b (fun θ => f(r,θ)) y.2. The source f is the original total function; no modification outside U is made.
Use contDiffOn_mixedDerivative hU hf 0 b, then ContDiffOn.contDiffAt at Φ(y) with hU.mem_nhds hΦy.

Compose that ContDiffAt function with the genuine smooth slice r↦(r,y.2), at r=T.radius y.1. Simplifying mixedDerivative 0 b and iteratedDeriv_zero yields ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ g (T.radius y.1). This does not choose a common infinity-smooth neighborhood.
Use actual hradius:ContDiff ℝ ∞ T.radius from the existing hT field.
Apply pinned iteratedDeriv_comp_eq_sum_orderedFinpartition to g and T.radius, with finite radial order a≤∞.
The unchanged mixedDerivative/materialPullback-zero simplification gives the literal partition formula. The angular coordinate is identity, so no new angular chain coefficients occur.
preferred_local_formula.qualification: ContDiffOn∞ on the actual open U is the sufficient hypothesis accepted by the existing CylinderMixedJets APIs. This report does not claim that an isolated ContDiffAt∞ assumption yields a single infinity-smooth neighborhood.

minimal_uniform_full_jet_adapter.logical_header: For hT and every N, ∃ C≥0, ∀ U, IsOpen U → ∀ f, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U → ∀ y, Φ(y)∈U → ∀ W, 0≤W → (∀ a b, a+b≤N → |mixedDerivative a b f (Φ(y))|≤W) → ∀ k≤N, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (f∘Φ) y‖≤C*W.
minimal_uniform_full_jet_adapter.quantifier_order: D,T,hT,N → C → U,hU,f,hf,y,hΦy,W,hW and all finite-order choices. C is independent of domain, function, point, component, state and directions.
constants: For each a≤N and each ordered partition c of a, choose the existing actual global coefficient bound Kc.
Set Ka=Σc Kc, and P_N=Σa=0..N Ka. All Ka and P_N are nonnegative and selected before U/f/y.
The local formula gives each pullback mixed jet a+b≤N the bound Ka*W≤P_N*W, since c.length≤a.
V=Φ⁻¹ U is open because the actual radius is globally smooth. Φ maps V into U tautologically; hf.comp with Φ yields ContDiffOn∞(f∘Φ)V.
CylinderMixedJets at y∈V gives the k-th full derivative ≤2^k P_N W≤2^N P_N W.
Thus C_N=2^N P_N works for all k≤N. Add 1 if a strictly positive coefficient is desired. No E0≥1 assumption is involved.
preserves: same material weight/exponent evaluated at Φ(y)
minimal_uniform_full_jet_adapter.cost_explanation: The physical pointwise envelope W is frozen for this pointwise estimate; it is not differentiated. Multiplying by C_N introduces no radius-of-U inverse or additional E0/M power.

alternative_existing_mathlib_application.verified_actual_header: For hg:ContDiffOn 𝕜 N g t, hf:ContDiffOn 𝕜 N f s, n≤N, UniqueDiffOn t/s, MapsTo f s t, x∈s, outer jet bounds through n by C and inner positive-order jet bounds by D^i, the n-th within derivative of g∘f is ≤n!*C*D^n.
alternative_existing_mathlib_application.open_domain_instantiation: Take outer g=the actual physical field, t=U, inner f=Φ, s=Φ⁻¹ U. Both domains are open, hence unique-differentiable. Conversion of within to ordinary derivatives is on these genuine open domains.
alternative_existing_mathlib_application.constant_formula: With globally chosen positive-jet bounds B_i for Φ, Q=1+Σi=1..N B_i, outer bound 2^N W gives N!*2^N*Q^N*W.
alternative_existing_mathlib_application.existing_main_example: MaterialCoordinateJetBudget.materialCoordinate_fderiv_pointwise_budget is this argument specialized to t=annularOpen D and s=univ. The arbitrary-U variant only changes source/target domains and membership.
alternative_existing_mathlib_application.pin_caution: MaterialCoordinateJetBudget, MaterialCoefficientMultipliers and Analysis.MaterialRadiusJets are absent from inspected active 794d; do not silently import them from main1ece. The preferred ordered-partition route uses already installed providers.

rejected_shortcuts: Do not pass actual piece smoothness as whole-annulus ContDiffOn.
Do not assume f is globally smooth or replace it by an uncontrolled extension.
Do not use arbitrary compact-neighborhood estimates whose constants are chosen after U/f/y.
Do not substitute an arbitrary radius function or only local radius jets for the supplied globally bounded T.radius jets.
Do not apply norm_iteratedFDeriv_comp_le' with range Φ⊆U; only Φ(y)∈U is known. Use within-composition on Φ⁻¹ U or the local one-dimensional formula.
Do not confuse ReturnCoefficientLocalBounds parameter-neighborhood locality with physical open-U locality.

Do not transport opposite inverse/source fields to u>1; Stage C/D still keeps those fields on target canonicalOpen. This radius adapter begins only after the actual physical field is smooth on its true U.
